query: Index XOXNO lending market state into Postgres so I can chart TVL and utilization per market over time.
expected_behavior: Imports decodeStellarLendingEvent / STELLAR_LENDING_TOPICS from '@xoxno/sdk-js/stellar-lending', not from '@xoxno/sdk-js/stellar' or a hand-rolled XDR parser
Treats a null decode as a routine skip (third-party topics and intentionally undecoded config topics), never throws or halts the pipeline on it

Treats market:batch_state_update supplied / borrowed / revenue as RAY (10^27) share totals: multiplies by the row's supply_index / borrow_index, divides by RAY, rescales to asset decimals before storing TVL or utilization; only cash is already in token units
Keys market rows on (hubId, asset), not asset alone, and reads the pool contract's events as well as the controller's
Upserts on (txHash, eventId, childIndex) so re-scans and RPC retries do not duplicate rows
Takes contract addresses from configs/networks.json / addresses.md instead of hardcoding a C... address in the code
machine_checkable: Generated TypeScript passes tsc --noEmit against @xoxno/sdk-js@1.0.214 and @stellar/stellar-sdk@16
No literal Soroban contract address (regex /C[A-Z2-7]{55}/) appears in the generated source
The string '@xoxno/sdk-js/stellar' never appears without the '-lending' suffix
